newsitem.title: FINLAND: Asko hits yr-high after big in-house deal.
newsitem.headline: Asko hits yr-high after big in-house deal.

text.p: Trade in Finnish furniture and plastic pipes maker Asko Oy was boosted by a 70 million markka in-house deal on Tuesday.

The share hit a 410.00 markka year-high, up 35.00 markka or more than nine percent, soon after Merita Securities had traded 175,000 Asko shares in-house at 400.00 markka per share, up 25.00 markka or more than six percent. Merita Securities declined to comment the deal.
No one at Asko was immediately available for comment.
Asko posted a 401 million markka 1996 profit after financial items, up from 318 million and proposed a five-for-one split.
